config.script:
system.perspective.openPopup(
	    'escalation',
	    'AlarmDemo/Popups/Escalation',
	    title='Escalation matrix',
	    modal=False, draggable=True, resizable=False,
	    position={'width': 780, 'height': 400})

if self.view.custom.pick0:
	    AlarmDemo.roster.addMember('Operations', self.view.custom.pick0)
	    self.view.custom.pick0 = ''
	    self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1

if self.view.custom.pick1:
	    AlarmDemo.roster.addMember('Maintenance', self.view.custom.pick1)
	    self.view.custom.pick1 = ''
	    self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1

if self.view.custom.pick2:
	    AlarmDemo.roster.addMember('Management', self.view.custom.pick2)
	    self.view.custom.pick2 = ''
	    self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1
